description: This file is a shell script used for testing Git's commit porcelain features, including message cleanup, trailers, and editor interactions.

methods.name: commit_msg_is
methods.description: Compares the latest commit message with an expected message.

methods.name: check_summary_oneline
methods.description: Checks the output of a git commit summary for correctness.

methods.name: trailer_commit_base
methods.description: Creates a commit with trailers for testing.

methods.name: output_tests_cleanup
methods.description: Cleans up the git testing environment after certain tests.

methods.name: try_commit
methods.description: Performs a git commit with optional template and checks the message accordingly.

methods.name: try_commit_status_combo
methods.description: Performs various commit tests with different statuses and configurations.
